title: spiral galaxy
note: Your year winds out from the center along a spiral arm. Brighter stars are busier days.

title: constellation
note: Active days are stars. Close days connect into constellations.

title: htop monitor
note: Months as system-monitor bars with percentages. Shows how busy each month was.

title: ridgeline mountains
note: One jagged line per month stacked on black, like the Unknown Pleasures album cover. Peaks are busy days.

title: vinyl record
note: A record with one ring of grooves per month. Every active day is a blip along its ring.

title: piano roll
note: Weekdays are piano keys, weeks run left to right, and every active day is a note. Longer notes are busier days.

title: tree
note: A tree grows a branch for every active week. Longer branches are busier weeks, and each leaf is an active day.

title: ocean waves
note: One wave per month, stacked in the sea. Taller swells are busier days.

title: space invaders
note: Every active day is an invader. Busier days are bigger, brighter invaders.

title: RPG status
note: A character sheet built from your year: level, XP and stat bars like HP and mana.

title: 3D skyline
note: A 3D city floating in space. One building per day, taller and brighter when you were busier.

title: terrain mesh
note: A wireframe landscape. Weeks run left to right, weekdays go into the distance, and height is how busy you were.

title: dig site
note: A cross-section of the ground. Every active week digs a shaft, deeper when busier, with a gem at the bottom.

title: obby course
note: An obstacle course of floating platforms, one for each active week. Higher platforms are busier weeks.

title: block stack
note: A falling-block puzzle. One column per month, stacked as high as the month was busy.

title: farm plots
note: A farm where every day is a plot. Busy days grow from a seed to a ripe crop.

title: test runner
note: Test-runner output: a row per month, a dot for every active day and a dash for every quiet one.

title: commit log
note: Your ten busiest days, sorted like terminal output with a bar for each.

title: aurora
note: Northern lights: curtains of light that swell in the weeks you were busy.

title: black hole
note: Your days orbit a black hole on an accretion disk, the newest days closest to the edge.

title: activity rings
note: Three rings: this week, this month against your best, and your streak against your longest.

title: year sparkline
note: The whole year as one smooth line, with your busiest week and today marked.

title: orbit rings
note: One ring per month. The dots on a ring are that month's days.

title: terminal heatmap
note: The usual grid, but drawn with text characters like command output.

title: radial bars
note: Every day is a spoke around a circle, longer for busier days. It starts at the top and runs clockwise.

title: tower
note: A tower with one floor per month. Wider floors and more lit windows mean busier months.

title: streak timeline
note: Every streak as a block along one year. Long streaks get a label.

title: moon phases
note: Each day is a moon: new when quiet, full when busy. Shows the last 26 weeks.

title: git graph
note: A main line with a node for every active week and branches that fork and merge back, like git log --graph.

title: hex dump
note: Each day is one byte. Busy days are bigger hex values, like opening a binary file.

title: topographic map
note: Contour lines rise around the weeks you were busiest, like a hiking map.

title: barcode
note: Your year as a product barcode. Thick bars are active days.

title: DNA helix
note: Two twisting strands with a rung for every active day.
